step1_analysis.description: A differential amplifier stage used in a fiber-optic receiver front-end. It features a differential pair with asymmetric active loads (an NMOS source-follower load and a PMOS current-source load) and cascode current sinks for biasing.

paper_reference.title: A Fully Integrated CMOS Receiver Front-End for Optic Gigabit Ethernet

voltage_gain.description: Mid-band AC voltage gain of the amplifier stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain = gm * Rout. With gm ~ 1-2 mS and Rout ~ 5-10 kOhm, the expected gain is roughly 5 to 20 V/V, which translates to 14-26 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Adjusted for SKY130 1.8V devices. The active loads will determine the exact output impedance, but 12-15 dB is highly typical for a single broadband stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cout). Assuming Rout ~ 5 kOhm and parasitic Cout ~ 50 fF, BW ~ 600 MHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The 40 GHz reported in the paper likely refers to the fT of the 0.35um process, not the circuit bandwidth. For a Gigabit Ethernet receiver, the circuit bandwidth should be around 1-2 GHz.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the stage.

sky130_expected.calculation: Power = I_total * VDD. Tail current ~ 1 mA, bias branches ~ 0.5 mA each. Total current ~ 2 mA. Power = 2 mA * 1.8 V = 3.6 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The '3 w' in the prompt is likely a typo for 3 mW, which perfectly aligns with the expected power of a single high-speed amplifier stage in CMOS.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, 3-dB bandwidth, and transient peak-to-peak output voltage. Missing bias nodes are pulled to VDD or driven with DC sources to establish a valid operating point.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully Integrated CMOS Receiver Front-End Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u
.param W_xm9=5u L_xm9=0.5u
.param W_xm10=5u L_xm10=0.5u
.param W_xm11=5u L_xm11=0.5u

XM1 N9 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N11 N10 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N6 N9 N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N2 LABEL_NET_3 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 N10 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N1 LABEL_NET_4 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N0 LABEL_NET_5 N9 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N7 LABEL_NET_6 N11 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}
XM9 LABEL_NET_7 N8 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9} w={W_xm9}
XM10 N3 N6 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm10} w={W_xm10}
XM11 N1 N0 N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm11} w={W_xm11}

* Power Supplies and Bias
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
V_N3 N3 0 1.8
R_N0 VDD N0 10k
R_N6 VDD N6 10k
R_N7 VDD N7 10k
V_N10 N10 0 0.9
V_N8 N8 0 0.9
V_N5 N5 0 0.9
V_L7 LABEL_NET_7 0 0.9
V_L2 LABEL_NET_2 0 0.9
V_L5 LABEL_NET_5 0 0.9
V_L6 LABEL_NET_6 0 0.9

* Differential AC and Transient Inputs
VINP LABEL_NET_3 0 0.9 AC 0.5 SIN(0.9 0.1 10Meg)
VINN LABEL_NET_4 0 0.9 AC -0.5 SIN(0.9 -0.1 10Meg)

.control
* DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VVDD)*1.8 - i(V_N3)*1.8
print power

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 20 100k 10G
let gain_db = vdb(N2)
meas ac mid_gain find gain_db at=1Meg
let gain_3db = mid_gain - 3
meas ac bw when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

* Transient Analysis
tran 1n 200n
meas tran vout_max max v(N2)
meas tran vout_min min v(N2)
let vpp = vout_max - vout_min
print vpp

quit
.endc
